name: Spanish
notes: Around 500 million native speakers across Spain and most of the Americas. Spelling is almost perfectly phonetic — once you learn the five vowel sounds you can pronounce any written word correctly, which makes it one of the fastest languages for an English speaker to become useful in.
syllabus: About 100 words and 30 verbs — roughly a fifth of CEFR A1, the first of six European levels (around 500 words and the present tense). A1 is enough to shop, ask directions and introduce yourself. The decks are a survival core, not a course.
